csv_project_name: Design for ACON CCON Wayfinding & Signage Refresh
csv_agency: City & County of Denver - Department of Aviation
csv_scope_of_work: This request is for a competitive Request for Proposal (RFP) between a qualified contractor and Denver International Airport (DEN). This design procurement supports professional signage and wayfinding consulting services for the Concourse A and Concourse C Wayfinding Refresh, building upon recently completed work on Concourse B. The scope includes review of existing wayfinding conditions, confirmation of key user touchpoints and sight lines, and development of coordinated signage and digital messaging recommendations aligned with current airport standard sand operational needs. Services include site analysis, evaluation of existing architectural and digital signage systems, documentation of required updates, coordination with airport stakeholders, and preparation of design and technical deliverables to support review, approval, and future implementation.
